::::::: hero-text
zen-do is a command-line interface (CLI) tool for preparing, managing, and
publishing Zenodo deposits from a metadata file and your existing research files
(e.g., code, data, metadata, documentation).

## :sparkles: Key features

- Quickly and easily initialize a [`.zenodo.toml`
  file](docs/design/interface/inputs.qmd) for preparing your project to be
  published on Zenodo.
- Manage your project on your Zenodo account from the terminal.
- Convert metadata between formats such as `.zenodo.toml`, `.zenodo.json`,
  `_quarto.yml`, `pyproject.toml`, and `CITATION.cff`
- Publish and update projects from the terminal.

## About the Seedcase Project

zen-do is part of the [**Seedcase Project**](https://seedcase-project.org),
which helps research projects manage and process data in line with the
[FAIR](https://www.go-fair.org/fair-principles/) principles.
